signLang.label: Sign language
signLang.chooseHint: Choose the sign language before starting the camera. Interface language and sign language are independent.
signLang.aslNotReady: The ASL model has not been trained yet, so ASL recognition is not available.
signLang.aslWordsNotReady: The ASL word model has not been trained yet (waiting for ASL Citizen data).

splash.tagline: Communication that understands you… even without words

modes.title: Choose a mode
modes.subtitle: Each mode is designed for a different way to communicate
modes.chatDesc: Type any sentence and the avatar signs it
modes.liveDesc: Fingerspell in front of the camera and it turns into text instantly

assistant.panelTitle: Type, and the avatar signs it
assistant.placeholder: Type a sentence to turn into signs...

live.title: Live conversation translation
live.defaultReply: Of course, how can I help you?
live.showHand: Show your hand to the camera
live.spellHint: Spell the word letter by letter, then lower your hand for a second to end the word
live.idleHint: Recognises letters and groups them into words
live.typeToSign: Type to turn text into signs...
live.noHandshape: No handshape for this letter in {lang}; only the text is shown.
live.struggleOnce: I'm here to help. It looks like this step is a little hard. Please sign it again.
live.struggleRepeat: This step seems difficult. Try spelling the word slowly, or type it in the box.
live.cameraDenied: Could not start the camera. Allow camera access in your browser and try again.
live.hintPhrases: Sign a phrase: "Assalamu alaikum" or "How are you" (original model, two phrases only)
live.hintAslWords: Sign a whole ASL word, then lower your hands; the model reads the movement
live.wordUnsure: The model is not sure. Closest: {words}

overview.tagline: Communication without limits · towards a more inclusive world

avatar.unsupported: Faded letters have no handshape yet, so they are shown as text only
avatar.noShapes: No {lang} handshapes yet, so the word is shown as text only
avatar.animationNote: Procedural fingerspelling (not motion capture of a Deaf signer)

privacy.title: Before the camera starts
privacy.camera: The camera runs in your browser. Only a cropped 64×64 hand image or hand landmarks are sent to the emaa server for recognition. Nothing is stored and no video is recorded.
privacy.limits: Translation is automatic and can be wrong. Do not rely on it for medical, legal or emergency situations; use a certified sign-language interpreter.

home2.lead: Instant translation between sign language and text, in Arabic and English.
home2.goSignD: Type, and the avatar signs it
home2.goTextD: Sign to the camera and see it as text

alert.struggle: Looks like something wasn't clear. Want the avatar to repeat it slower?
alert.wrongLangAr: This text is in Arabic but ASL is selected. Switch to Arabic sign language?
alert.wrongLangEn: This text is in English but Arabic sign language is selected. Switch to ASL?
alert.lowConfidence: The model isn't sure about the sign. Move your hand closer to the camera and use better lighting.
alert.partnerStruggle: Looks like something is hard to understand. Want the avatar to repeat the reply slowly?
